title: Du'ā for Tranquility and Opening of the Heart
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْزِلْ عَلَيَّ سَكِيْنَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ تَشْرَحُ بِهَا صَدْرِيْ وَتَحْفَظُ بِهَا قَلْبِيْ
transliteration: Allāhumma anzil ʿalayya sakīnatan min ʿindika tashraḥu bihā ṣadrī wa taḥfaẓu bihā qalbī.
translation: Oh Allah, descend upon me tranquility (satisfaction) that comes from you, and open my chest and protect my heart with it.
